description: DEMOLITION OF EXISTING GARAGE AND REAR EXTENSION, CONSTRUCTION OF  A TWO STOREY SIDE EXTENSION, PART SINGLE PART TWO STOREY REAR EXTENSION, HIP TO GABLE LOFT CONVERSION INCLUDING REAR DORMER EXTENSION AND ROOFLIGHTS TO THE FRONT, CHANGES TO THE REAR FENESTRATION.
decision_conditions: <table style="border:undefined; margin-bottom:5px; width:100%" class=" cke_show_border"><tbody><tr><td style="width:12%"><span style="line-height:1"><span style="font-size:11pt; text-align:justify"><span style="vertical-align:top"></span></span></span></td><td style="width:88%"><span style="line-height:1"><span style="font-size:11pt; text-align:justify"><span style="vertical-align:top">The proposed development, by reason of its combined siting, design, scale, width, depth, height, bulk and massing, would constitute an unsympathetic and disproportionate form of development that would fail to remain subordinate to the host dwellinghouse. The cumulative impact of the two storey side extension and part single part two storey rear extensions would result in an overly dominant, contrived and cumbersome addition that would erode the original form, proportions and character of the dwelling and unbalance the appearance of the semi-detached pair, to the detriment of the character and appearance of the surrounding area. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies D12.1, D12.3 and D12.4 of the Merton Local Plan (2024).</span></span></span></td></tr></tbody></table>
